sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND (p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING sum(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) = 'number' THEN CASE WHEN abs(((e.properties -> $3::text))::numeric) <= 1e300 THEN ((e.properties -> $3::text))::float8 END END) >= $4::float8))
